name: MED_THERAPY_PROB_INFO
description: This table contains basic information about a medication therapy problem.

columns.name: PROBLEM_ID
columns.description: The unique identifier (.1 item) for the medication therapy problem record.

columns.name: PAT_ID
columns.description: The unique ID of the patient record for this row. This column is frequently used to link to the PATIENT table.

columns.name: PAT_ENC_CSN_ID
columns.description: The unique contact serial number for the patient encounter where this medication therapy problem was created. This number is unique across all patient encounters in your system. If you use IntraConnect, this is the Unique Contact Identifier (UCI).

columns.name: CREATION_USER_ID
columns.description: The unique ID associated with the user who created this medication therapy problem. This column is frequently used to link to the CLARITY_EMP table.

columns.name: CREATION_USER_ID_NAME
columns.description: The name of the user record. This name may be hidden.

columns.name: DEPARTMENT_ID_EXTERNAL_NAME
columns.description: The external name of the department record. This is often used in patient correspondence such as reminder letters.

columns.name: EPISODE_ID
columns.description: The unique ID associated with the episode that this medication therapy problem is linked to.

columns.name: MTP_CONTEXT_C_NAME
columns.description: The context category ID for the medication therapy problem.

columns.name: RESPONSIBLE_USER_ID
columns.description: The unique ID associated with the user responsible for the resolution of this medication therapy problem.

columns.name: RESPONSIBLE_USER_ID_NAME
columns.description: The name of the user record. This name may be hidden.

columns.name: COMMENTS_NOTE_ID
columns.description: The unique ID of the note that contains additional information documented for this medication therapy problem.

columns.name: SOURCE_TASK_ID
columns.description: The unique ID of the task record that this medication therapy problem was created from.

columns.name: CURRENT_MTP_STATUS_C_NAME
columns.description: The current status of the medication therapy problem.

columns.name: CURRENT_MTP_RATIONALE_C_NAME
columns.description: The rationale behind why this is a medication therapy problem.
entries: No medical indication at this time
